name: film.coach-fit
description: Screen one candidate resource, service or coach for Jacob Rodgers (class of 2029, 6'5" 290 OL/DL, Pewaukee HS, Wisconsin, age 15) whose stated need is to read Hudl game film better and understand the game, plus have a person to talk with weekly about it. Input is one candidate: what it is, who teaches, what it costs, how it is delivered. This gate screens and ranks; it never books, never pays, and never contacts anyone -- a minor's lane and any spend are Gate-D.

teaches_film_reading.instructions: How much of this product teaches the ATHLETE to read and grade live game film and understand schemes, opponents and tendencies -- as opposed to physical technique only, or software/storage only.
criteria: Nothing about film: strength, drills, camps, storage or stats only
Mentions film in passing; the deliverable is technique or software
Some film content, generic, not tied to the athlete's own game tape
Teaches a weekly film-preparation method applied to the athlete's own game film
Film reading is the core product, position-specific, with a named person grading his own plays

weekly_human.instructions: What kind of recurring HUMAN contact the candidate actually offers, since the ask is a person to talk with every week, not a library.

criteria.weekly_1x1: A named individual coach, recurring weekly, 1-on-1 with the athlete (scheduled cadence, e.g. a weekly Zoom or standing in-person session)
criteria.on_demand_1x1: A named individual coach, 1-on-1, bookable per session with no standing weekly cadence
criteria.group_sessions: Recurring human coaching but in a group/class or team setting, not 1-on-1
criteria.self_paced_only: Courses, videos, books, forums or software; no live human
criteria.none: No human instruction offered at all
criteria.unclear: The page does not say whether a human is included

trench_specific.instructions: The offering is specific to offensive line / defensive line play (footwork, hands, run game, pass protection, front identification, line-side film reads) rather than all-positions or a skill-position specialty.

athlete_facing.instructions: Can a family buy this and have the athlete be the learner? TRUE for an independent coach hired privately by a family for one athlete, and for programmes sold to athletes. FALSE for things a team, school or coaching staff must buy (program software licences, team subscriptions), for education whose learner is the COACH (clinic videos, coaching certifications, scouting-credential courses), and for camp or combine formats where the athlete attends a group event rather than being taught.

access_mode.instructions: How a Pewaukee, Wisconsin athlete would actually consume it, judged from the stated service area.

criteria.in_person_wisconsin: In-person sessions available in Wisconsin, realistically reachable from Pewaukee / the Milwaukee metro (includes southeastern Wisconsin sites)
criteria.remote_serves_anywhere: Delivered online (Zoom/video) so geography does not bind it
criteria.in_person_other_state: In-person only, and the facility is outside Wisconsin

price_published.instructions: A concrete price or price band is published and readable, so the family can decide without first getting on a sales call.

monthly_cost_band.instructions: Estimated recurring cost to run this weekly for one month, from the published figures. A weekly 1-hour session at a per-session rate multiplies by 4.

criteria.unknown: No figure published to derive it from

minor_supervision.instructions: An adult can put a 15-year-old into this 1-on-1 safely and auditably: a named coach with a public identity, a guardian-visible or recorded session, a known facility or organisation, and no requirement to chat privately with an anonymous stranger. An anonymous marketplace profile with no channel a parent can read scores low.

coach_credibility.instructions: Evidence, on the candidate's own page, that the people teaching have actually developed linemen at a level above high school -- college or pro playing/coaching record, named staff, verifiable results.
criteria: A name and a claim, nothing checkable
Named instructor with a plausible college or competitive background
Named instructor with a verified college/pro playing or coaching record
Established programme with multiple verifiable staff and a track record of athletes advancing

duplicating_existing.instructions: This duplicates something the family already runs or owns: Hudl access to the full Pewaukee tagged play library with per-play cut-ups and end-zone angles, an automated nightly AI film-review routine that already drafts coaching notes four nights a week, and existing position trainers the athlete already sees in person. A candidate that only repeats that coverage scores high.

recruiting_value.instructions: Beyond film IQ, this plausibly improves how he looks to college coaches: it raises the quality of his film and how he talks about it, or the provider's identity and network are themselves coach-facing credibility.

rules.reason: teaches no film reading -- technique, camp, software or stats only; does not answer the ask
coach-facing or program-facing product; a 15-year-old is neither the buyer nor the learner
already covered in-house by Hudl library access plus the nightly film-review routine -- a second system doing the same job
position mismatch -- a defensive back, quarterback or all-skills specialist teaching an offensive/defensive lineman; the film reads he needs are front-seven reads
1-on-1 with an adult and no auditable or guardian-visible channel -- verify before anyone is booked
no human at all: this is a library, keep it as a resource, it does not satisfy the weekly person
self-paced only -- useful as supporting material, not the weekly conversation
the page does not say a person is included -- confirm before shortlisting
no checkable coaching record behind it
no published price -- get a number before proposing it to the family
over roughly $400 a month -- that is Gate-D spend, Mike approves
delivery location not stated -- confirm he can actually get to it

notes.direction: PASS means 'shortlist this and put it in front of the family'. It is not permission to book, pay, or message a coach: this is Lane C (a minor) and every outward or paid step stays at Gate-D. Ranking is the primary verb -- it needs no calibration.
notes.why_no_block_on_cost: Price alone never blocks: a weekly human coach is worth money and the family decides value. Cost only escalates so the number reaches Mike rather than being discovered after a booking.
notes.why_minor_supervision_escalates: The bar for this lane is child safety, not a platform rule, so it is not Mike's to relax: an anonymous marketplace 1-on-1 with a stranger is exactly the shape this rule exists to catch.
notes.why_location_is_a_choice_not_a_score: Pewaukee is the constraint that kills most national programmes, but remote delivery dissolves it, so geography is scored as reachability rather than distance. in_person_other_state escalates on nothing here by design -- it should read as a camp or a season commitment, not a weekly session.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated, same standing as every advisory rubric in this directory: verdicts are reported, enforced=False, and BLOCK rules report downgraded-BLOCK reasons until labelled. Calibrate against already-decided candidates before it is allowed to enforce.
notes.ranking_gotcha: Because this rubric is never_auto, the engine appends one constant 'rubric is marked never_auto' ESCALATE line to EVERY candidate, so the raw tripped count carries +1 on all rows and is not comparable across rubrics. When ranking, drop any reason containing 'never_auto' and sort on the remaining findings -- a candidate whose only tripped line is never_auto is a clean PASS on merit. Measured 2026-09-30 on a 15-candidate rank: all 15 reported ESCALATE, which was this constant plus uncalibrated floors, not 15 rejections.
